elements.text: How would you categorize the area in which you live?

buttons: Urban/large city (residing inside of a major city, e.g., Roanoke, Richmond, Virginia Beach)
Urban/small city/town (residing inside of a small city or town, e.g., Charlottesville, Lynchburg, Salem, Blacksburg)
Suburban (residing outside of a city or town, e.g., in a county outside but near Charlottesville)
Rural (residing outside of urbanized areas, not near a city)
